reason: Zero-MELO uses test-time tree search for localized evidence and score calibration, improving micro-gesture accuracy over Qwen2.5-VL on two datasets. The full text describes additional iterative inference and does not establish a compute/latency reduction; task-specific robustness is a weak efficiency-lineage link.
title: Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition
